race.comment: EMALYN (2) resumed with a bold win here over 900m a fortnight ago when trekking the pace, before stretching out impressively to score by over length. She cops an extra 2kg, but that should not be enough to stop her from repeating the dose. STRATAFY (1) resumes a very suitable level for this handy mare, and she normally comes to hand quickly. A recent trial on the Beaumont course here will have her primed for a big effort fresh, especially with a 3kg claim to ease her top weight burden. PRECIOUS GIRL (4) has been patiently handled, and has the draw to receive a cosy run early on. She won her maiden here fresh up over this trip at the end of February, and will be ready to rumble. BETHSHEBA (6) stuck on bravely at long odds here over this trip 4 weeks ago when trapped wide from a tough gate. She cops another tricky draw, but is still worth including in all top 4 combos. WAVETON (7) set the pace and weakened quickly at Goulburn last start over 1100m on soft track. Don't drop her yet.
